features.notes: Drawing/chart parts and relationships are retained when connectivity checks pass. A loaded workbook may rename a sheet and update qualified chart <c:f> references; bounded edits cover selected series formulas, caches, marker attributes, solid RGB line/fill colors, smooth, negative-value display, and visibility flags, title, legend, axes, style, and data labels. BUILD-stage creation covers line/bar/area/pie charts and additional series in an existing Drawing. The single line-chart reopen smoke test passed on macOS Excel; bar-only and multi-chart/bar creation outputs trigger Excel recovery. An independent LibreOffice probe also refused the generated multi-chart/bar file, although ZIP and XML checks passed. The new chart result is not accepted as reusable evidence, so excel_reopen remains unverified.

Pivot cache owner and reachable parts are preserved when validated. A loaded workbook may rename a sheet and update worksheetSource@sheet; general source/cache edits and pivot recalculation are not implemented.

Worksheet drawing and legacy-drawing owners are restored only when their relationships and reachable targets survive. Bounded edits cover existing anchor markers, shape metadata/text, hidden/rotation/flip, preset geometry, and selected RGB fill/line properties; drawing creation and broad object editing are not supported.
External URLs are never fetched or executed. External-reference owner XML may be preserved when its relationship is valid; external-reference formulas are not evaluated.
